claim_one_line: THE CODEX TRANSCRIPT HARVEST (owner-relayed working transcript, not their commits alone). (1) R022 DOES NOT REFUTE B1182, and the boundary is pinned: their transcript summarises R022 as 'the original three-way field-labelled identification is FALSE', which read alone looks like a refutation of T-V4-TORSOR-IDENT -- a theorem THIS BENCH REGISTERED HOURS EARLIER at B1214. It is not: R022's negative is BRANCH vs BEING-x-HEARING (separated by sqrt3 vs sqrt5 and ramification {2,3} vs {3,5}), while B1182's theorem is the SQRT(-3)-INTERNAL pair (frame V4 = <c,r> and branch V4 = Gal(Q(zeta12)/Q)) -- no being-x-hearing, no sqrt5. OUR OWN BANKED RECORD SETTLES IT (B1175's charter text: 'C4 REFUTED-AS-STATED by the author -> C4' (the sqrt(-3)-internal pair, R022's frozen-data spec; BEING x HEARING DROPPED)') -- B1182 IS C4', the pair that survived R022's negative; the three-way OA-C1133 stays ill-typed and open. (2) THEIR WRAPPER FLAG IS REAL AND THREE OF THE FOUR WERE MINE FROM TODAY: of 52 reproduce.sh wrappers, 4 printed REPRODUCES with NO GATE on the computation's own output -- asserting success on the process exiting 0 rather than on the computation asserting anything -- and B1210/B1211/B1213 were written by this seat in the same session that banked B1207's lesson about instruments that cannot fail. THE FOURTH IS WORSE: B1175's wrapper RE-RUNS NOTHING AT ALL, echoing conclusions and printing REPRODUCES, for certificates that live on codex's branch and are not vendored -- corrected to print RECORD with the reason at the top of the file ('a reproducer that reproduces nothing is worse than no reproducer, because it answers the question it was never asked'). Ungated now: 0. (3) THE STALLED LEAD CARRIED ONE STEP -- codex's last finding before their quota ran out, uncertified by them: the tail-selection equation cannot be copied from the quark leg to the lepton leg, because for A_11 the required raw B-pair sum is 4 mod 12 rather than 8. CHECKED HERE FROM THE SPEC'S OWN NUMBERS: the invariant is the RAW TOTAL (the three raw characters (7,6,2) sum to 3 mod 12), so rho+sigma = 3 - chi(A) mod 12, which REPRODUCES THE SPEC'S OWN STATED RULE (8) for A_7 and gives 4 for A_11 -- CODEX'S ARITHMETIC IS CONFIRMED and the rule is not a constant. The instrument is CALIBRATED BY THE SPEC rather than chosen: a first pass allowed character 10 and produced a fourth A_7 pair (10,10) the spec does not list, so the alphabet runs 0..8 and the spec's list (0,8),(2,6),(4,4) pins it; on that alphabet A_11 gives (0,4) and (2,2), and (2,2) IS REPEATED so it vanishes by the same skewness that killed (4,4) in the down case. FENCED: that the lepton leg IS A_11 is a reading of codex's frames, which are not on this bench and which their own certificate leaves UNDETERMINED at generation level -- this verifies the CONSEQUENCE, not the reading. CONDITIONAL CONSEQUENCE for B1208's fork: IF the lepton leg is A_11 its tail structure DIFFERS from the down leg's, which is evidence AGAINST branch (a) (same tensor) and toward (b) or (c), without deciding between them since the connecting contributions are untouched. (4) THEIR HONEST NINE-STEP SM CHAIN ADOPTED as an external reading (bare 'not nothing' does not uniquely select a seed; Fibonacci conditional; the carrier conditional; GIVEN m004, m004 -> 2T -> E6 PROVED; E6 supplies an exact SM-shaped skeleton; a unique compact 4d QFT functor NOT derived and unrestricted uniqueness REFUTED; the heterotic construction a conditional witness not an object-forced realization; three chiral generations NOT derived; vacuum/spectrum/Yukawas/dynamics/values unclosed) with their summary -- 'genuine structural mathematics, but not yet a parameter-free Standard Model or TOE' -- which is our position too, and worth more to the paper written by a hostile-audit seat than by us. Their ledger now types 185 questions: 70 PROVED, 55 REFUTED, 15 CONDITIONAL, 22 EXTERNAL_BLOCKER, 2 EMPIRICAL, 21 OPEN. CARRIED NOT ACTIONED: the paper branch's '112-member' verifier still running its withdrawn 14-member census (cc3's, relayed) and outside scripts on floating git refs (cloud's). Gate 5 clean.
